notes:
Based on what I found on the operators' own pages:
```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Learn to Swim: Parent and Tot / Preschool, Town of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Preschool levels through Preschool E, with children who are five years old moving on to Swimmer programs",
      "when": "Fall registration opens Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.; program options browsable online starting August 4",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville Parks and Recreation"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool Swim Lessons, Goldfish Swim School Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Part of the structured stages swimmers move through as they grow out of the school's 4-months-to-12-years learn-to-swim program",
      "source_name": "Goldfish Swim School Oakville"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on sourcing: 
The Town of Oakville offers lessons according to the Lifesaving Society Swim for Life program, and children must be the age required for the level they are taking by the program start date.
 
Children who are five years-old do not need to complete all preschool levels before moving to the Swimmer programs, and children who have completed the Preschool E and who are five years old should enrol in Swimmer 2.
 The town's own booking page confirms 
fall recreation and culture program registration opens Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m., with program options available to browse online starting August 4
 — no specific day/time or price for the preschool level was posted yet in what I read, so those are left off.

For Goldfish, their own FAQ page notes 
enrollment begins at four months, and as swimmers grow, preschool swim lessons strengthen coordination and floating control in structured stages
, and 
the learn-to-swim facility welcomes aspiring swimmers between the ages of 4 months and 12 years old
 — no specific fall schedule or price was on the page I read, so I've left those out too.

I did not include the YMCA of Oakville or Making Waves Swim School as picks: the YMCA's own page gives ages only for its Parent & Tot level (3–35 months, a toddler band), not for the next level up, and Making Waves' Oakville page advertises fall registration generally but doesn't state a preschool-specific age range — so I couldn't fill in a trustworthy age_fit for either from what's posted.
